threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [S] Auto-degrading peek to a FULL JUMP on tiny terminals is surprising behavior — you asked to peek and got teleported. Safer degrade: show a one-line message ('window too small to peek — enter to jump') and do nothing. Flagging because I wrote the surprising version first.

Anchor.selected_text: - **Tiny terminals** — peek overlay on small windows. Mitigated: reuse the help-overlay sizing conventions; peek degrades to full jump below a minimum height.
Anchor.context_before: - **Jump-into-doc disorientation** — landing in a second commented doc mid-review. Mitigated: breadcrumb header + backspace always returns; accepted beyond that.

Replies.Author: rcliao

threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [Q] Design wrinkle I glossed over: 'only style what resolves on disk' puts filesystem checks in the render path, but rendering functions are pure by contract (pkg/tui/CLAUDE.md). Resolution needs to happen once at doc load (cached ref map), not per render. I believe that's the right fix but it means stale styling if a target file appears/disappears mid-session — acceptable?
threads.SectionPath: Reference Jump: Citations Between Docs (RPI Support) > Risks

Anchor.selected_text: - **False-positive references** (a `word:12` that isn't a path) styled as links would erode trust in the styling. Mitigated: path-shaped heuristic + only style what resolves on disk.
Anchor.context_after: - **Jump-into-doc disorientation** — landing in a second commented doc mid-review. Mitigated: breadcrumb header + backspace always returns; accepted beyond that.

Replies.Text: Cached ref map at load, pure render preserved; stale styling accepted and noted in Risks.

threads.Author: claude
threads.Text: [B] Weakest spot in the heuristic: my own example breaks it. research.md:42 contains no slash, so it only matches via the extension rule — but the extension is followed by :42, so the matcher must parse path.ext:line as a unit, not check suffix. The test list in DoD covers this, but the heuristic sentence as written would reject the doc's canonical example.
threads.SectionPath: Reference Jump: Citations Between Docs (RPI Support) > Proposed Design

Anchor.selected_text: - Bare file:line tokens: `research.md:42`, `pkg/tui/model.go:123` — must look like a path (contains `/` or ends in a known text extension) to avoid false positives on ratios like `3:5`

Replies.Author: rcliao
Replies.Text: okay to have this syntax and handle at error handling in peek
Replies.SectionPath: Reference Jump: Citations Between Docs (RPI Support) > Proposed Design

Replies.Author: claude
Replies.Text: Adopted: syntax stays, parser handles path.ext:line as a unit, failures surface as the peek error state. DoD updated.

threads.Text: [Q] Resolve ambiguity: [NEEDS CLARIFICATION: should `f` peek first (enter to commit to the jump), or jump immediately with peek as a modifier? Peek-first is proposed — checking a finding is the common case, full reading the rare one — but this is a daily-feel choice.]
